mapper.select: SELECT id, kind, start_at, end_at, start_date, end_date, title FROM schedule WHERE (user_id = #{userId}) AND ((start_date <= #{date}) AND (end_date >= #{date}))
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO schedule (user_id, kind, start_at, end_at, start_date, end_date, title) VALUES (#{userId}, #{kind}, #{startAt}, #{endAt}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{title})
mapper.update: UPDATE schedule SET kind = #{kind}, start_at = #{startAt}, end_at = #{endAt}, start_date = #{startDate}, end_date = #{endDate}, title = #{title} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.schedule_id, c.color, c.memo, s.kind, s.start_at, s.end_at, s.start_date, s.end_date, s.title FROM calendar_event c INNER JOIN schedule s ON c.schedule_id = s.id WHERE c.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO calendar_event (schedule_id, color, memo) VALUES (#{scheduleId}, #{color}, #{memo})
mapper.update: UPDATE calendar_event SET schedule_id = #{scheduleId}, color = #{color}, memo = #{memo} WHERE id = #{id}
